relationships.operation: Regulate adipose-derived endocrine signalling and local glucocorticoid responsiveness to communicate metabolic state and coordinate hormonal adaptation.

scientific_assessment.operation: Regulate adipose-derived endocrine signalling and local glucocorticoid responsiveness to communicate metabolic state and coordinate hormonal adaptation.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Established in rodent models only: administered urolithin A raised circulating adiponectin and adipose Adipoq, and increased adipose tissue T3 through DIO2 with thyroid-hormone-dependent fat loss. Human adipose endocrine engagement has not been measured.

dietary_exposure.statement: Dietary ellagitannin sources raise urolithin A in producers: urinary urolithin A rose with walnut intake in DIRECT-PLUS, plasma urolithin A glucuronide marked mixed-nut exposure, and pomegranate juice produced variable urolithin A exposure.

targeted_searches.query: Urolithin A food sources; ellagitannin and ellagic acid composition of walnuts and pomegranate
targeted_searches.outcome: Urolithin A is not present in foods; it is formed from ellagitannins and ellagic acid. Foods are projected through PM8-DIT-14 and the related-substance catalogue, never as urolithin A containment.

scientific_assessment.scope: Adipose endocrine signal modulation demonstrated preclinically; not a human efficacy, dose or VAT-reduction claim.
scientific_assessment.approval_source: Owner instruction, 12 November 2026: reassess urolithin A for Decision 1 (Zelicha 2022 VAT association and animal evidence), add a urolithin A dietary lever with walnuts (as studied) and pomegranate (ontology) stating the animal-data limitation, add a Scientific Hypothesis, and research and score as appropriate.

relationships.biological_role: Microbial metabolite of dietary ellagitannins that raised circulating adiponectin and local adipose thyroid-hormone activation in rodent obesity models.
relationships.dietary_input_note: Type B regulatory relationship admitted with a preclinical-evidence limitation on owner instruction (12 November 2026). Dietary delivery is precursor-mediated through ellagitannin-rich foods; supplements are not equated with food.
relationships.limitation: Endocrine engagement is demonstrated in animal studies only, using administered urolithin A. In humans, a rise in urinary urolithin A tracked visceral-fat loss but was not randomised, and four-month supplementation did not change fat mass. Production depends on gut microbiota and varies between people; no food-effective dose or human adipokine effect is established.
relationships.qualification: Type B regulatory relationship admitted with a preclinical-evidence limitation on owner instruction (12 November 2026). Dietary delivery is precursor-mediated through ellagitannin-rich foods; supplements are not equated with food.

conversion_pathway.process: Hydrolysis of ellagitannins releases ellagic acid in the gut lumen.

evidence.statement: Ellagitannin-rich pomegranate juice produced variable downstream urolithin A exposure in healthy adults, consistent with hydrolysis to ellagic acid before microbial conversion.

conversion_pathway.limitations: Hydrolysis extent varies with food matrix and ellagitannin structure; no food-to-ellagic-acid yield is established.

conversion_pathway.process: Gut microbial conversion of ellagic acid through intermediate urolithins to urolithin A.
dependencies: Urolithin-producing gut microbiota (Gordonibacter and Ellagibacter-related taxa); producer status varies between people

evidence.statement: Human intestinal Gordonibacter species converted ellagic acid to intermediate urolithins; complete urolithin A production depends on the wider community.

conversion_pathway.limitations: Non-producers form little or no urolithin A; the species studied did not complete conversion alone.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Engagement is through the derived target, urolithin A, and is established in rodent models only (see PM8-DIT-13).

dietary_exposure.statement: Walnut intake (28 g/day in DIRECT-PLUS) correlated with a rise in urinary urolithin A; pomegranate ellagitannins produced variable urolithin A exposure.

targeted_searches.query: Walnut kernel and pomegranate ellagitannin composition
targeted_searches.outcome: Walnut ellagitannins recorded as present without an established quantity (Regueiro et al. 2014); pomegranate ellagitannins and ellagic acid retained from Gil et al. 2000. No quantity is converted into a urolithin A amount.

scientific_assessment.scope: Precursor provision for urolithin A in producers; not a producer-independent or dose claim.
scientific_assessment.approval_source: Owner instruction, 12 November 2026: reassess urolithin A for Decision 1 (Zelicha 2022 VAT association and animal evidence), add a urolithin A dietary lever with walnuts (as studied) and pomegranate (ontology) stating the animal-data limitation, add a Scientific Hypothesis, and research and score as appropriate.

relationships.biological_role: Dietary polyphenols hydrolysed to ellagic acid, which producer gut microbiota convert to urolithin A.
relationships.dietary_input_note: Derived precursor relationship supporting PM8-DIT-13; no extra-intake benefit, dose or producer-independent effect is implied.
relationships.limitation: Food ellagitannin content is not a urolithin A amount. Conversion depends on hydrolysis and producer microbiota; some people produce little or none. Walnuts were the studied DIRECT-PLUS food; pomegranate is included from the ellagitannin ontology, not from an adipose endocrine trial.
relationships.qualification: Derived precursor relationship supporting PM8-DIT-13; no extra-intake benefit, dose or producer-independent effect is implied.
